mapper.select:
select p.PROD_ID id, p.PROD_NAME text from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO p where p.`STATUS` = 'E'
and p.PROD_ID IN (#{initValue})
and ( p.PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or p.PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select p.PROD_ID as prodId,/** 产品代码**/ p.PROD_NAME as prodName,/** 产品名称**/ p.REG_CODE as regCode, /** 理财信息系统登记编码**/ p.IVSTORIENTATION as ivstorientation,/** 投资性质**/ p.CASH_PRIN_CCY as cashPrinCcy,/** 兑付本金币种**/ p.RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel,/** 产品风险等级**/ p.VDATE as vdate,/** 起息日**/ p.IN_DEP_NAME as inDepName,/** 境内托管机构名称**/ p.OUT_DEP_NAME as outDepName, /** 境外托管机构名称**/ p.CUSTOMER_TYPE as customerType,/** 客户类型**/ case when p.IN_DEP_NAME is not null and p.OUT_DEP_NAME is not null then concat_ws('、',p.IN_DEP_NAME,p.OUT_DEP_NAME) when p.IN_DEP_NAME is not null and p.OUT_DEP_NAME is null then p.IN_DEP_NAME when p.IN_DEP_NAME is null and p.OUT_DEP_NAME is not null then p.OUT_DEP_NAME else '' end as depName, /** 境内托管机构名称 + 境外托管机构名称**/ '华夏理财有限责任公司' as managerName /** 产品管理人**/ from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO p where p.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select distinct a.ASSET_CODE as assetCode,/** 行内资产负债编码**/ a.ASSET_NAME as assetName,/** 资产名称**/ a.ASSET_TYPE as assetType,/** 资产类型**/ a.ASSET_TYPE2 as assetType2,/** 资产/负债二级类别**/ a.FINANCIE as financie,/** 融资人**/ a.ASSET_YIELD as assetYield,/** 项目收益率(利率)%**/ a.MDATE as mdate /** 到期日 **/ from CHB_INVEST_TRADE t, CHB_ASSET_INFO a where t.ASSET_CODE = a.ASSET_CODE and a.`STATUS` = 'E' and t.`STATUS` = 'E' and a.ASSET_TYPE2 in ( select SRCFIELD1 from chb_type_mapping_ex where MAPPINGCODE = 'ChbInvestOperation001' ) /** 指定非标资产的类别**/ and t.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.DEALDATE = #{dealdate,jdbcType=DATE} and t.CUR_ASSET_TYPE = #{curAssetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by a.ASSET_TYPE2, a.ASSET_CODE
